analysis: The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md. The supplied units are base-side excerpts of historical changelog text at lines 1911-2739, whose changed ranges are on the base at lines 11-13 and on the head at 11-100. The changes are documentation only: a heading and release-notes section for a v0.10.1 candidate. No executable source, protocol, authorization, encryption or build configuration changes appear in the supplied evidence. The patch excerpt is truncated (patch_excerpt_complete=false) and the head-side text is not supplied, so the rest of the new v0.10.1 section (head lines about 11-100) was not seen. Read as far as it goes, the visible excerpt describes a rollout dependency on a platform coordinator change (darkbloom-platform#411) that refuses logprobs for certain models. This is external to the supplied evidence and unverified here. It also mentions a libs/mlx-swift-lm pin bump and a page-cache accounting change that affects load admission and KV budgets. The visible base text also contains prior-release notes on SSD prefix checkpoints, which relate to T-041 and SEC-035. Those are pre-existing description of earlier shipped behavior, not changes in this PR, and I do not restate them as new issues. Remaining integration questions for a later pass: (1) whether the code changes the changelog describes (the mlx-swift-lm pin bump, the page-cache accounting changes, and the GLM-5.3-Flash / Nemotron request-validation changes) are in other files and need their own security review; (2) whether the cache-accounting change alters admission safety (T-016, T-029). No finding is warranted from the changelog text alone. This is not a full security audit.
